source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 276 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 276 was established by Ordinance No. 19669, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 16, 1987. Ordinance No. 19669 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 276 is established on property generally fronting on the southwest line of Lamar Street, northwest of the southwesterly prolongation of the northwest line of Garden Drive. The size of PD 276 is approximately 11.334 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must conform to the development plan (Exhibit 276A). (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.105. USES.

(a) No smelting of lead, breaking of batteries, or storage of battery parts are permitted on the Property.

(b) Only uses allowed in an I-2 Industrial District as set forth in Chapter 51 are permitted in Zone 1 of the Property.

(c) Only the following uses are permitted in Zone 2 of the Property:

(1) A metal processing facility.

(2) A salvage or reclamation (outside) use.

(3) A metal smelting and plating use.

(4) All uses allowed in an I-2 Industrial District as set forth in Chapter 51. (Ord. 19669)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.106. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must comply with the landscape plan (Exhibit 276B). (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Permanent Buildings
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.107. PERMANENT BUILDINGS.

All structures on the Property must have permanent foundations. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.108. SCREENING.

A visual screen that is no less than nine feet in height and that consists of solid masonry or concrete must be provided as shown on the landscape plan. The fence must be maintained in good condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Stacking Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.109. STACKING HEIGHT.

The stacking height of objects is limited to a maximum of eight feet within 40 feet of the visual screen. At points more than 40 feet from the visual screen, additional stacking height is permitted if the additional stacking height is no more than one foot higher for each five feet of setback from the 40-foot point. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area Ratio
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.110. FLOOR AREA RATIO.

Maximum permitted floor area ratio on the Property is 1:1. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.111. HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height of any structures on the Property is 50 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.112. PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided for each use to meet the requirements of Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.113. PAVING.

All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets must conform to the requirements of Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.114. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the regulations established in Chapter 51 for business zoning districts. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all codes and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this ordinance, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-276.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 276 is located on Zoning Map No. L-8. (Ord. Nos. 19669; 25711)
